sloka: स तु दृष्ट्वा बलं सर्वं रावणो निहतं क्षणात् ।क्रोधमभ्यगमत्तीव्रं महानादं च मुक्तवान् ।। ७.२९.५ ॥
transliteration: sa tu dṛṣṭvā balaṁ sarvaṁ rāvaṇo nihataṁ kṣaṇāt ।krodhamabhyagamattīvraṁ mahānādaṁ ca muktavān ।। 7.29.5 ॥

translations.english: Seeing his entire army destroyed in an instant, Rāvaṇa indeed became intensely angry and let out a great roar.
